templates.name: Enterprise RAG System & Document Chatbot Job
templates.hook_opening: I can architect and deploy a zero-hallucination, secure RAG chatbot for your [document type / platform] using LangChain, Pinecone, and AWS security protocols.
templates.template_text:
Hi [Client Name / Hiring Team],

I can architect and deploy a zero-hallucination, secure RAG chatbot for your [document type / platform] using LangChain, Pinecone, and AWS security protocols.

In a recent enterprise build, I engineered a HIPAA-compliant RAG system indexing over 100,000 internal clinical PDFs using hybrid keyword + semantic reranking—achieving 99.4% accuracy with zero data leakage to public models.

TECHNICAL ROADMAP FOR YOUR BUILD:
1. Ingestion & Chunking: Automated parsing of your [data sources] using optimal token boundaries.
2. Vector Indexing: High-performance semantic search using Pinecone / pgvector.
3. Guardrails & Citation: System prompt guardrails requiring exact source attribution links.
4. Production API: FastAPI backend + clean embeddable web widget.

I've attached a 2-minute video walkthrough of a similar RAG knowledge platform I recently deployed. Would you be open to a quick 10-minute call to review your document ingestion scope?

Best regards,
Alex | Enterprise AI Architect

templates.name: Autonomous AI Agent & Multi-Agent Swarm Job
templates.hook_opening: Your requirement for an autonomous multi-agent workflow aligns perfectly with my recent work building stateful agent swarms using LangGraph and CrewAI.
templates.template_text:
Hi [Client Name],

Your requirement for an autonomous multi-agent workflow aligns perfectly with my recent work building stateful agent swarms using LangGraph and CrewAI.

Instead of basic linear prompt chains, I engineer multi-agent systems with explicit role delegation, state persistence, and human-in-the-loop fallback checkpoints.

HOW WE WILL STRUCTURE YOUR AGENT SWARM:
• Agent 1 (Researcher): Ingests and parses incoming payload data from [APIs / Sources].
• Agent 2 (Analyst): Processes data against your business logic and evaluates rules.
• Agent 3 (Auditor): Runs security & compliance verification before finalizing output.

You receive 100% clean Python source code, complete Docker configuration, and an operational guide. Let's schedule a brief call to align on your workflow logic!

templates.template_text:
Hi [Client Name],

I can streamline your operational workflow by building a custom, fail-safe n8n automation pipeline connecting [App 1, e.g., HubSpot] with [App 2, e.g., OpenAI API] and [App 3, e.g., Slack].

I specialize in building self-healing n8n pipelines equipped with automated error-handling, rate-limit management, and instant notifications if an external API fails.

WHAT YOU GET:
• Fully configured n8n workflow (self-hosted or n8n cloud).
• Custom JavaScript / Python nodes for advanced data transformations.
• 5-minute video walkthrough explaining workflow management.

Let me know a good time to connect on Upwork Messages!
